title: eq swap
system_instruction_addendum: EQ SWAP ADDENDUM: Crossfade with EQs, not the crossfader. Cut deck a's lows as you raise deck b's lows. Frame it as a band-by-band hand-off.

tutor_speak.text: the eq swap is a transition without the crossfader. you cut deck a's bands one by one as you raise deck b's matching bands.
start with the lows. drop deck a's low knob, then raise deck b's low knob on the next beat one.

hints.text: the low knob is at the bottom of the channel strip.
turn it all the way down: you want the bass gone from deck a.
cut deck a's low eq knob to its minimum.
